seoBlock.title: Luxury bag rental in Spain
seoBlock.p1: Semzo Privé is a luxury bag rental service in Madrid and Marbella. Our collection includes iconic models by Chanel, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Hermès and other prestigious fashion houses, available through a flexible and accessible membership system.
seoBlock.p2: Renting a luxury bag gives you access to exclusive pieces for special occasions or everyday use, without any permanent commitment. With 24-48 hour delivery and insurance included, Semzo Privé offers a modern and sustainable way to enjoy luxury fashion.

faqs.q: I've just signed up, what happens next?
faqs.a: You'll receive a welcome email with the steps to activate your account. Once your identity is verified, you can choose your first bag from the collection available for your membership. We ship it to your home within 24–48h in mainland Spain.
Monthly memberships renew each month and you can cancel at any time before the next charge. The quarterly membership has an initial 3-month commitment and then renews quarterly.

faqs.q: How many bags can I enjoy each month?
faqs.a: The L'Essentiel, Signature and Privé memberships include one bag per month from their corresponding collection. The Petite membership works differently: you can purchase weekly Bag Passes from any of the three collections, up to 4 bags per month (one per week).

faqs.q: How long can I keep my bag?
faqs.a: For the entire duration of your active membership. When you want to swap it for another, request the exchange from your private area and we collect the current one when delivering the new one.

faqs.q: What happens if I lose or damage a bag?
faqs.a: All memberships include coverage for everyday wear. In the event of serious accidental damage or loss, contact our team immediately and we will guide you through the resolution process, with no surprises or fine print.
Yes. Each piece is authenticated by experts before joining the collection and checked again between rentals. We work exclusively with original pieces from the world's most renowned luxury houses.

faqs.q: How do I cancel my membership?
faqs.a: From your private member area you can cancel at any time, with no penalties. You keep access until the end of the period already paid for.

faqs.q: Do you ship outside mainland Spain?
faqs.a: We currently operate in mainland Spanish territory. We are working to expand to the Balearic Islands, Canary Islands and the rest of Europe soon. Subscribe to our private list to be among the first to know.
